brief: THE BET — a 150–300-line diff is expected and welcome. The map's shape has not changed in 68 iterations, and the only way across the river is the lane bridge at the bottom of the frame: every east arrival bound for the far bank enters by EAST_GATE_P / PARK_GATE at y 60, so the plaza, the quay and the jetty at JETTY (128.4, 35) never exchange anybody. Build a FOOTBRIDGE across the river at the alley's latitude (ALLEY_Y 31), so alley → plaza → quay → deck → towpath at the jetty is one straight line across the east half. A NEW tile kind (DECK = 12, add it to __census's TN[]) over the WATER cells x RIVER_X0..RIVER_X1 for two or three rows in buildGrid; drawn as a light timber or iron span with handrails and its own shadow on the water, high enough that the rowboat passes UNDER it (updateBoat runs y −7 → 93 at x 116.5–121.5 — draw the deck after the boat when the boat is under it, and give the moment its own announce line like the lane bridge's boatUnder). Then USE it: the towpath/green/bandstand branches of spawnEastAgent (roll 0.62–1.0) all lead [[PARK_GATE, 60.5], …]; let those who start from the town side (EAST_GATE_A) cross the deck instead, and let a share of plaza/quay visitors walk over to the jetty and back, so the deck carries people in both directions through the day. Add the deck to byTheWater() so crossers watch the boat. Price the routes with pathHours() and print alley→jetty before and after. This brief MUST move tileKinds (11 → 12) and water in the census: run the gate, read it for collapse only, then pin the new baseline with census.mjs --save-baseline and say so in the entry.
successLooksLike: From the wide shot a second, lighter crossing sits a third of the way down the river with people on it in both directions inside the first minute; the rowboat passes under it and the sill says so; the census reads tileKinds 12 and water down by the deck's cells, the baseline re-pinned on purpose; alley→jetty pathHours falls from most of a day to a few hours; lanePk/eastPk unchanged.
avoid: Do not reuse drawBridge — it is a stone three-arch at the frame edge; this is a footbridge and should look like one. Do not route the boat around it or stop it. Do not add a new arrival source or widen eastCap — this is a ROUTE change on the existing east budget (its arrivals retrace, so a deck crossing is walked both ways for free). Do not put the deck at the jetty's exact row if that hides the jetty.
